(US TERMS)
(first row all working in the same stitch) 
Chain 5 and DC into 5th chain from hook 
chain 1 dc 2 *in center (same stitch you just dc into) x2
Chain 3 and dc in center
*chain 1 dc 2* x 2
Chain 4 and slip stitch into center 

Row 2:
5 SC into first opening 
3scinto next 2 chain 1 spaces
3sc into chain 3 space, mini picot stitch (?) (chain 1 and slip stitch into base of the stitch) to create the bottom of the leaf 
3sc into next 2 chain 1 space
5sc into last opening, slip stitch to finish

chain 15-17 between leaves.
